note: Sports hall: long single-storey block north of the garden with a covered gallery on red steel posts along its south side. Frame x along the south wall from its SW corner, y north, z above the gallery deck / FFL. Scale check FAILED on frame A_16: the recovered camera sits only 0.18 m above the deck with a 6 m bay, so the bay length and all heights are unverified (orange).
